statement: Most surfaced eBay H100 80GB listings show sellers located in China offering free delivery, with some U.S.-based sellers.
why: A resale channel dominated by China-based sellers indicates prior-generation accelerators are circulating out of that market, which is an alternative-supply route around new vendor allocation.

impact.mechanism: China-based resale supply of prior-generation accelerators adds a secondary channel of available compute hardware outside vendor allocation of new parts.

evidence.source: eBay search results (via web search snippets)
evidence.excerpt: Most listings show sellers located in China offering free delivery, with some U.S.-based sellers.

confidence.basis: Seller-location impression from search snippets rather than the fetched marketplace pages; no counts or totals available.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 2 -> 1; sources: StorageReview, eBay search results (via web search snippets)
